leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define a structured type for image objects with required properties.
Implement a React functional component with TypeScript to serve as the main gallery container.
Use the useState hook to create and manage an array state variable for storing gallery images.
Apply array iteration with the map method to render each image object as a visual element.
Construct JSX elements with appropriate HTML attributes to display image thumbnails in a grid layout.
Utilize CSS classes and inline styles to control the visual presentation and responsiveness of the gallery.
Implement event handlers to manage user interactions like clicks on gallery images.
Execute conditional rendering to display different UI states based on component data or user actions.
Define and invoke helper functions to perform operations like filtering or sorting the image collection.
Use the useEffect hook to perform side effects such as loading initial image data from a mock source.
Apply prop drilling or context to pass data and functions between parent and child gallery components.
Return structured JSX that combines state, iteration, and conditional logic into a complete gallery interface.
